column3: Close to the Greek; “You say it” is rendered “It is as you say.”
NKJV adds “but He answered nothing,” a phrase found in some manuscripts but not in the critical text.
NKJV has “testify against You,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “accuse You.”
NKJV has “crying aloud,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “having come up.”
Close to the Greek; “cohort” is rendered “garrison.”
Close to the Greek; “kneeling down to” is rendered “worshiped.”
NKJV has “they gave Him … to drink,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “they offered Him.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV supplies “above.”
This verse is absent from the critical text; NKJV includes it following the Textus Receptus (“He was numbered with the transgressors”).
NKJV has “come down,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “by coming down.”
